item: kill a background task from the roster (11.3): hover-✕ on a bg-row sends stop_task, row dims until the CLI's next roster frame
branch: renderBgTasks(): each row with a task_id gets .bg-x; click → bridge{kind:'stopTask', id} once (a second click is swallowed), row.stopping; the next background_tasks_changed REPLACES the set (never optimistic removal). `ambient:true` tasks are excluded from the roster and the suspend count.
provenance: background_tasks_changed{tasks[{task_id,task_type,description,ambient?}]} is the CLI's 2.1.250 schema read from the binary (`strings`), same shape fixture 04 uses. stop_task{task_id} accepted over stdio — probed 2026-08-23 (success; unknown ids also answer success). The bridge verb is OUR side; whether the CLI actually kills the task is hand-verified against a real task in the sandbox (journal 2026-08-28). NEGATIVE CONTROLS: step 3 (a roster frame that still lists the task keeps the row, still dimmed — no optimistic removal), step 5 (ambient tasks draw no row).

steps.note: live: two tasks on the roster, each row carries a ✕; clicking one sends stopTask for THAT id and dims the row
